title: Athens War Museum

buildingCutout.basis: The exact museum roof extent replaces only the closely coincident procedural building.

terrainReference.basis: Original open elevation at the center of the mapped atrium.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap museum building relation 1231213 and the independently named grounds.
mapIdentity.scope: OSM building relation 1231213 and its two closed members precisely identify the upper exterior roof perimeter and the separate central atrium opening. The containing named museum grounds are way 318587299 (Q1788831).

note: The Hellenic tourism organization and museum history confirm a modernist building opened in 1975. Firsthand research published in Public Humanities describes the recessed ground storey, deep cantilevered windowless upper gallery and square open atrium.
